newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March 1st 20 days trade surplus falls 33.8%.
newsitem.headline: Japan March 1st 20 days trade surplus falls 33.8%.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus in the first 20 days of March fell 33.8 percent from a year earlier to 337.48 billion yen compared with a revised surplus of 509.51 billion yen in the same period last year, the Finance Ministry announced on Monday.
Free on board (FOB) exports rose 12.3 percent from a year earlier to 2.72 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 24.6 percent to 2.38 trillion yen.
